findings.suggested_fix: Add `type ExitReason string` with the closed set {ExitSilentComplete, ExitSLADeadline, ExitHardLimit, ExitForced}, plus `ExitDecision{Exit, Reason, Summary, SummaryDegraded}` and `EvalOpts{DryRun, Origin}` to internal/topic, matching contracts/README.md lines 112-127 verbatim (which explicitly states 'T001 交付' and that README overrides individual task contracts on conflict). Without these, T004's EvaluateCard signature and T008's replay-diff comparison (which the seam manifest ties to this exact enum) cannot be implemented against the declared contract. Constitution P9 底线④ names 'contract seam deviation (interface signature ... not matching contract)' as an unwaivable floor defect at any tier.

Cards()/Links() only copy the outer slice (`copy(out, s.cards)`); store.TopicCard.Reporters ([]string, schema.go:480), store.TopicCard.ClaimedBy (*TopicCardClaim, schema.go:491), and store.CardLink.Score (*float64, schema.go:551) remain shared with the internal state, contradicting the method's own doc comment ('只读视图，调用方不得据此假设底层共享内存'). This reproduces the exact shallow-copy defect T001-topic-model.md's own revision history calls out as a real (not ruler-ambiguity) implementation defect, and which seam-manifest.yaml's SEAM-SCRATCH-STATE entry documents as a prior acceptance-review blocker fixed via a deep per-field copy + a TestScratchDeepCopyCoversAllReferenceFields guard — neither is present here. Do a field-by-field deep copy (clone Reporters slice contents, clone *TopicCardClaim/*float64 pointee) and add the guard test before T003/T008 start writing/reading this concurrently.

seam-manifest.yaml's SEAM-DEPS/SEAM-CARD-MUTEX entries declare a `CardMu *CardMutex` field on topic.Deps attributed to a 'v13 裁决', but the actually-committed contracts/README.md is v11 and its Deps code block (lines 96-110) has no such field — nor does T001-topic-model.md v6. The diff correctly matches the committed contract (verified via TestContractShapes, which passes), so this isn't an implementation bug, but the design docs disagree with each other on whether the card-level keyed mutex primitive (plan.md's primary concurrency-safety mechanism — 'unique index is only the last line of defense') belongs in T001's Deps. Reconcile: either backport CardMu into README.md/T001-topic-model.md §一 and re-open T001, or correct/version the seam manifest so it stops citing an unlanded ruling as current source-of-truth for T002-T008 implementers who will read the seam manifest and expect the field to exist.

T001's grant has `db_writes: []`, while T001-topic-model.md §三 explicitly authorizes writes to topic_cards (state field via Transition), our_members, topic_metrics (via Count), and config_ops (registry audit) — and internal/topic/registry.go does perform literal InsertOne/UpdateOne writes to our_members and config_ops. Every other task (T002-T008) has its db_writes list correctly populated from its own §三 grant; T001 alone is empty, which looks like a data-entry gap in the M2 migration artifact rather than a real code violation. If any downstream tooling enforces this manifest as a hard authz gate (per the commit message 'A 产物 authz 过闸'), populate T001's db_writes with [suiyin_desk.topic_cards, suiyin_desk.our_members, suiyin_desk.topic_metrics, suiyin_desk.config_ops] to match the contract before it's relied on as ground truth.
